zh: 咱们用AI的时候，有没有这种感觉？
en: Do you ever get this feeling when using AI?

zh: 客户要得特别着急，你让AI帮你写回复，它写得特别快。
en: A client needs an urgent reply, and AI writes one very quickly.

zh: 你让它做一个方案，它也能给你一大段。
en: Ask it for a proposal, and it can produce a long draft too.

zh: 可你关掉对话框以后，资料还得自己找。
en: But once you close the chat, you still have to find the materials.

zh: 表格还得自己填，客户还得自己回。
en: You still fill in the sheet and reply to the client yourself.

zh: 真出了问题，还得是你兜着。
en: And if something goes wrong, you are still accountable.

zh: AI确实帮你把最开始那一下做掉了。
en: AI really did handle that first step for you.

zh: 只是你以为后面也被它做了，实际上还没有。
en: You may think it handled everything after that, but it did not.

zh: 问题来了：豆包、DeepSeek、Kimi、千问这些你都会用。
en: Here is the question: you can use Doubao, DeepSeek, Kimi, and Qwen.

zh: 那么，你算不算会用AI？
en: Does that mean you truly know how to use AI?

zh: 先别急着问算不算，看看AI后面的工作是不是还由你接着干。
en: Before answering, see how much work after AI still has to be carried by you.

zh: 今天我就把用AI分成六个段位，你们看我说得对不对。
en: Today I will divide AI use into six levels. See whether this makes sense.

zh: 第一层：问答。
en: Level one: question and answer.

zh: 手机里常用的豆包、DeepSeek、Kimi、千问，大多先解决问答。
en: Doubao, DeepSeek, Kimi, and Qwen on our phones mainly start with Q and A.

zh: 你问一句，它答一句；改文案、查思路、想标题，它很快给你参考。
en: You ask, it answers. It quickly suggests copy, ideas, or titles.

zh: 最大的好处，是人不容易卡在空白页上。
en: The biggest benefit is that you are less likely to get stuck on a blank page.

zh: 但边界也很清楚：答案停在聊天框里。
en: But the boundary is clear: the answer stays inside the chat box.

zh: 后面怎么改、怎么发、发给谁，发错了怎么办，还是你自己处理。
en: You still decide how to edit it, send it, who receives it, and fix mistakes.

zh: 别因为会提几个问题，就觉得用上Agent了；它只是反应很快的助手。
en: Asking a few questions does not mean you use an Agent. It is only a fast assistant.

zh: 那怎么到第二层？第二层就是任务。
en: How do you reach level two? Level two is a task.

zh: 它不再是一句“帮我想想”，而是有资料、有要求、有交付物的一件事。
en: It is no longer "help me think," but a task with inputs, requirements, and a deliverable.

zh: 比如把上周十几条客户咨询整理成一张跟进表。
en: For example, turn last week's client inquiries into a follow-up sheet.

zh: 把一堆会议记录变成老板看得懂的简报。
en: Turn a pile of meeting notes into a briefing the boss can understand.

zh: 把已有资料按固定格式整理成一份文档。
en: Organize existing material into a document with a fixed format.

zh: Kimi文档、飞书表格、千问办公、WorkBuddy，
en: Kimi Docs, Feishu Sheets, Qwen Office, and WorkBuddy

zh: 还有通用助手的任务功能，都能从这一层进。
en: plus task features in general assistants can all enter from this level.

zh: 把资料、目标和最终交付都给它，让它把具体办公任务往前推。
en: Give it the material, goal, and desired output so it can advance a concrete office task.

zh: 到第二层，要学的不是提示词多花，而是把活说清楚。
en: At level two, the skill is not fancy prompts but describing the work clearly.

zh: 给它什么资料、做成什么样、哪几步不能错。
en: Specify the inputs, the required result, and which steps must not be wrong.

zh: 别把“能下载一个文件”当成任务完成。
en: Do not treat a downloadable file as proof that the task is done.

zh: 名字对不对、数字有没有错、结论能不能发，还是得你看。
en: You must still verify names, numbers, and whether the conclusion can be sent.

zh: AI帮你把毛坯搭起来，最后交付的责任还在你手上。
en: AI builds the rough draft, but responsibility for delivery remains with you.

zh: 第三层才是流程，因为有些事情根本不是做一次。
en: Level three is a workflow, because some work is never done only once.

zh: 每天有咨询、整理表格、提醒跟进，这些事一直重复。
en: Inquiries, spreadsheets, and follow-up reminders repeat every day.

zh: 再靠手动复制、粘贴、转发，人很快就烦，也容易漏。
en: Manual copying, pasting, and forwarding soon becomes tiring and error-prone.

zh: n8n、Dify、Zapier这类工具，主要是把几步事串起来。
en: Tools such as n8n, Dify, and Zapier mainly connect several steps.

zh: 表单进来后分类、写入表格、提醒负责人，需要人看就停下来让人接。
en: A form is classified, written to a sheet, and assigned; it pauses when a person must review.

zh: 这才叫流程，不是某一次AI帮你做得快。
en: That is a workflow, not AI completing one isolated task faster.

zh: 流程越往外连，越不能图省事。
en: The farther a workflow reaches, the less you can cut corners.

zh: 客户回复、订单、钱和敏感资料，只要自动往外发，
en: Whenever customer replies, orders, money, or sensitive data are sent automatically,

zh: 就要先想好谁有权限、谁点确认，跑错了谁来停。
en: decide who has permission, who confirms, and who stops it when it fails.

zh: 第四层是组装：读本地文件、改网站、接接口，或拼成自己的小系统。
en: Level four is assembly: read local files, edit sites, connect APIs, or build a small system.

zh: Codex、Claude Code、Cursor，还有这类编码Agent，
en: Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and coding Agents of this kind

zh: Agent Harness也常见在这一层。
en: including Agent Harness are common at this level.

zh: 它已经不只是聊天框，而是工具怎么接、工作区怎么放、任务怎么协同。
en: It is no longer just chat, but how tools connect, workspaces are organized, and tasks cooperate.

zh: 它们能看代码、改文件、跑命令，但新的门槛也出现了：
en: They can inspect code, edit files, and run commands, but new barriers appear:

zh: 文件在哪、环境怎么配、接口怎么接、权限怎么给、报错怎么查。
en: Where are files, how is the environment set up, how do APIs and permissions work, and how are errors traced?

zh: 我自己感受很深：别人看着一句话做出来，真跑起来是一个报错接一个报错。
en: I know this well: it looks like one sentence built it, but running it brings error after error.

zh: 所以不只看提示词，要看它改了什么，结果是不是真的跑通。
en: So do not judge the prompt alone. Inspect what changed and whether it truly runs.

zh: 第五层：开源改造。
en: Level five: open-source modification.

zh: GitHub、Gitee第一次打开，很多人会觉得又是看不懂的网站。
en: When people first open GitHub or Gitee, many see another confusing website.

zh: 它不是聊天软件，里面放的是公开项目和零件。
en: It is not chat software; it hosts public projects and reusable parts.

zh: 把代码拉下来，配合Git、Docker去安装、部署和修改。
en: You pull the code and use Git and Docker to install, deploy, and modify it.

zh: 但别把“下载成功”理解成“我有产品了”。
en: But do not mistake a successful download for owning a product.

zh: 项目跑起来后，更新、漏洞、数据和故障恢复，这些活不会消失。
en: After launch, updates, vulnerabilities, data, and recovery work do not disappear.

zh: 真正看的是能不能接住后续维护，而不是会不会点星。
en: What matters is whether you can maintain it, not whether you can click Star.

zh: 第六层叫系统经营，没有什么“第六层神器”。
en: Level six is system operation. There is no magical level-six tool.

zh: 企业把AI接进多人协作、资料和业务时，通常是一套东西一起工作。
en: When AI enters team collaboration, data, and operations, a whole stack works together.

zh: 模型或API提供能力，Dify、n8n组织流程，知识库放资料；
en: Models or APIs provide capability, Dify and n8n organize workflows, and a knowledge base stores data;

zh: 代码仓库和部署工具记录版本，再加权限、日志、备份和人工审核。
en: repositories and deployment tools track versions, alongside permissions, logs, backups, and human review.

zh: 最难的已经不是选哪个模型。
en: The hardest part is no longer choosing a model.

zh: 资料谁维护、哪些人能看、AI说错了谁接住？
en: Who maintains the data, who may see it, and who catches AI mistakes?

zh: 钱花到哪儿、哪一步出错，能不能找到记录并恢复？
en: Where was money spent, where did it fail, and can records be found and restored?

zh: 企业真把AI用进去，最后绕不开这些事。
en: A company truly using AI cannot avoid these responsibilities.

zh: 别因为接了知识库、连了几个Agent，就觉得企业完成AI转型。
en: Connecting a knowledge base and several Agents does not complete an AI transformation.

zh: 工具堆在一起，不等于系统能在真实业务里跑下去。
en: A pile of tools is not a system that can keep running in real operations.

zh: 看到这，来说说你现在在哪一层？
en: So, which level are you at now?

zh: 回想最近一件事：AI给完答案后，哪一步最费时、最容易错，还必须你接住？
en: Think of one recent task: after AI answers, which step is slowest, riskiest, and still yours to catch?

zh: 如果是整理资料，就先把第二层学明白。
en: If it is organizing information, first master level two.

zh: 如果是每天重复搬运，就去看第三层。
en: If it is repetitive transfer every day, look at level three.

zh: 如果准备接文件、接口和真实业务，再去碰第四层以后的东西。
en: If you are connecting files, APIs, and real operations, then move to level four and beyond.

zh: 先看AI已经替你干到哪儿，你准备在哪儿把它接住。
en: See how far AI already works for you, then decide where you will take over.

zh: 不管你在哪一层，有问题或工具不会用，留下困惑，我来一一解答。
en: Whatever your level, leave your questions or tool problems and I will answer them.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州AI创业。
en: I am Chao Ge, building an AI business in Lanzhou.
